question.text: Per the current NISM II-A workbook (p.92) and Section 42 of the Companies Act 2013, what is the maximum number of allottees in a private placement in a financial year (excluding QIBs and employees granted securities under an ESOP scheme)?

answer.text: 200 allottees excluding QIBs and employees under the ESOP scheme (or such higher number as may be prescribed)
25 allottees including all categories of investors

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 92 of the current NISM II-A workbook states that allottees in a private placement shall not exceed 50 or such higher number as may be prescribed. The currently prescribed limit is 200 allottees in a financial year, excluding QIBs and employees granted securities under the ESOP scheme. The 50-allottee legacy figure is the workbook baseline; the prescribed higher number (200) is the current operative cap. The Trap: The 50-allottee figure is the legacy baseline from the bare statutory text; the prescribed higher number is the current cap. The exclusion of QIBs and ESOP employees from the count is critical. Cross-Exam Context: NISM II-A Chapter 8.1 and NISM IX (Merchant Banking) both test the private-placement cap and the prescribed-higher-number caveat.
